messages.subject: Ironhold IBR - data room and timetable
messages.plaintextBody:
Aisha,

The data room is open - management accounts to January, the FY26 budget and the 13-week cashflow are all loaded. Whitfield Carter will need your base case to size the new-money facility and the covenant reset. Can we hold to a 19 March delivery?

Robert

--
Calverton Industries Limited
Calverton House, Ryebank Road, Redditch B98 8LG

messages.subject: RE: Ironhold IBR - data room and timetable
messages.plaintextBody:
Robert,

19 March works. Early read: FY25 covenant leverage lands around 4.9x and EBITDA recovers to c.8.9m in FY26 on the budget. I'll share the integrated model and a sensitised low case. The Redditch consolidation is the main swing factor on the cashflow.

Aisha
